items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Or you'd go to Clarke Monroe's Uptown House... I'm trying to think of that boy that was in love with Tallulah Bankhead... There were two places that you could go. And if you'd happen to do that you'd see--you'd go to Clarke's Uptown House* you'd see Mickey Rooney, or Cary Grant...

ctx.x:
+Sugar Hill, a modestly well-to-do section in the western part of Harlem.
*i.e.- Clark Monroe's Uptown House.
